name: Trastuzumab deruxtecan (T-DXd)
cyclesNote: Continued every 21 days until progression or unacceptable toxicity. Tissue-agnostic use for HER2-expressing (IHC 3+, or IHC 2+) urothelial carcinoma after prior systemic therapy.

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

biomarkers.note: Trastuzumab deruxtecan is a HER2-directed antibody-drug conjugate delivering a topoisomerase I inhibitor payload. Used tissue-agnostically for HER2-expressing tumors (IHC 3+, or IHC 2+) after prior systemic therapy, including urothelial carcinoma.

premedications.name: Antiemetic prophylaxis
premedications.notes: trastuzumab deruxtecan is moderately-to-highly emetogenic; give appropriate antiemetic prophylaxis before each infusion.

supportiveCare: INTERSTITIAL LUNG DISEASE / PNEUMONITIS: monitor for new or worsening cough, dyspnea, or fever; hold and evaluate promptly, and permanently discontinue for grade >= 2 ILD.
Monitor CBC for neutropenia and anemia before each dose.
Assess left ventricular function periodically (HER2-directed therapy).
monitoring: chest imaging and pulmonary symptom review for interstitial lung disease before each dose

doseModificationRules.condition: any grade interstitial lung disease / pneumonitis
doseModificationRules.text: Interrupt for suspected ILD and evaluate; permanently discontinue for grade >= 2 ILD/pneumonitis and treat with corticosteroids per labeling. Physician decides.
Hold until recovery and reduce dose per labeling for grade 4 neutropenia or febrile neutropenia; obtain clinical review.

drugs.name: Trastuzumab deruxtecan
drugs.notes: Trastuzumab deruxtecan 5.4 mg/kg IV on day 1 of a 21-day cycle. Interstitial lung disease / pneumonitis is a serious risk requiring proactive monitoring and prompt interruption. Dose per standard tissue-agnostic HER2 practice (Standard Guidelines / DeVita / Harrison, general reference).

provenance.locator: Principles of Systemic Therapy, HER2-expressing later-line (tissue-agnostic)
